literal: Because of the existence of the exceedingly great beauty called graciousness, this world exists.
translation: This world continues to exist only because of the presence of that exceedingly great beauty called graciousness.
modern: கண்ணோட்டம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் மிகச் சிறந்த அழகு இருப்பதனால்தான் இந்த உலகம் நிலைபெற்றுள்ளது.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that graciousness or kindly consideration is the ultimate beauty of human nature. The author describes this quality as an 'exceedingly great beauty' (கழிபெருங் காரிகை). The existence of the world and human society depends entirely on the presence of this virtue. Without empathy and benignity among people, social life would disintegrate, meaning the world exists only because of this grace.
